title: How crop improvement works: genes, pollination and hybrid seed

say: How crop improvement works: genes, pollination and hybrid seed.
This is the video for module 1 of Agricultural Hybridization and Crop Improvement.
What you see in a plant comes from its genes plus its environment: soil, rain, weeds, pests and fertiliser.

say: Genes come in pairs, one from each parent. For example, Ngozi in Enugu State crosses a pure yellow maize with a pure white maize. Yellow is dominant, meaning it hides white.

panel.heading: Ngozi's cross: the 3 to 1 pattern
items: Pure yellow YY x pure white yy

say: Every seed in the first generation, called F1, gets one yellow and one white copy. All show yellow grain.

panel.heading: Ngozi's cross: the 3 to 1 pattern
items: Pure yellow YY x pure white yy

say: She plants the F1 seed and lets the plants pollinate each other.

panel.heading: Ngozi's cross: the 3 to 1 pattern
items: Pure yellow YY x pure white yy

say: In the second generation, three of every four combinations carry yellow.

panel.heading: Ngozi's cross: the 3 to 1 pattern
items: Pure yellow YY x pure white yy

say: On a cob of 400 kernels, she expects about 300 yellow and 100 white. That splitting is why saved hybrid seed does not stay true.

panel.heading: Ngozi's cross: the 3 to 1 pattern
items: Pure yellow YY x pure white yy

say: In self-pollinated crops like rice, cowpea and groundnut, pollen usually comes from the same flower. Saved seed stays close to its parent.

panel.heading: Self-pollinated and cross-pollinated
left: Plant is mostly its own father
Saved seed stays close to type

say: In maize, the tassel sheds pollen and the wind carries it to the silks of other plants. Pollen from a neighbour's field can change your next crop.

panel.heading: Self-pollinated and cross-pollinated
left: Plant is mostly its own father
Saved seed stays close to type

say: A hybrid is the F1 of two chosen inbred parents. But saved hybrid seed becomes an F2, with uneven plants and much less vigour. So buy fresh hybrid seed every season.

panel.heading: Hybrid or open-pollinated variety
right: Seed can be saved and replanted
Lower seed cost; can be shared

say: An improved open-pollinated variety, or OPV, comes from a research institute. You can save its seed for a few seasons. It depends on your cash, inputs and market.

panel.heading: Hybrid or open-pollinated variety
right: Seed can be saved and replanted
Lower seed cost; can be shared

say: For example, Halima farms 1 hectare of maize near Zaria. She compares a hybrid with an improved OPV, both sown at 20 kg per hectare.

card.title: Halima's seed cost over three seasons

say: Hybrid seed at about 5,000 naira per kg costs 100,000 naira every season, so 300,000 naira over three seasons.

card.title: Halima's seed cost over three seasons

say: Certified OPV seed at about 2,500 naira per kg costs 50,000 naira in season 1.

card.title: Halima's seed cost over three seasons

say: Then she keeps back 20 kg of her own grain each season, worth about 14,000 naira, so 28,000 naira for two seasons.

card.title: Halima's seed cost over three seasons

say: The hybrid costs about 222,000 naira more in seed. It is worth it only if its extra harvest, after extra fertiliser, is worth more than that.

card.title: Halima's seed cost over three seasons
rows: Extra seed cost of the hybrid

say: For example, Blessing farms in Niger State. Her must-haves are white grain and maturity within her season.

panel.heading: Blessing ranks three varieties
items: Trial B and A against her usual seed

say: She weights her nice-to-have traits: drought tolerance 4, yield potential 3, streak virus resistance 2,

panel.heading: Blessing ranks three varieties
items: Trial B and A against her usual seed

say: and seed price 1. The weights add up to 10.

panel.heading: Blessing ranks three varieties
items: Trial B and A against her usual seed

say: She scores each variety from 1 to 5 and multiplies by the weights. Variety B scores 41, A scores 39 and C scores 29.

panel.heading: Blessing ranks three varieties
items: Trial B and A against her usual seed

say: She drops C. B and A go into a trial beside her usual seed. Her own trial decides.

say: Before the season, write your goal and must-have traits. Choose even land with the same soil and slope.
Set aside cash for seed and the fertiliser it needs. Get a notebook or sheet ready, and know your ADP extension agent.

panel.heading: Ready to trial a new variety?
items: Seed and input budget set aside

say: To remember. Only genes pass on in seed. A uniform F1 splits in the next generation, so buy fresh hybrid seed each season. Maize crosses easily, so it needs isolation. And start from a written goal, not a colourful seed bag.
